name: Virgil “Gold Tooth” Floyd
appearance: Broad-shouldered, graying hair, impressive mustache, prominent gold tooth.
portrayal: Charismatic, affable, quick-witted, unusually difficult to offend; easygoing but not foolish.
source_profile:
Guildmaster of the Wayward League.

"Well now, look what the cat dragged in. How'd the wilderness treat you this time, friends?"

Virgil is a former adventurer who has seen more than his share of the world and decided that
running a saloon full of dangerous misfits is preferable to getting himself killed.

Virgil knows that adventurers are a contentious, frequently irresponsible lot. He's developed an
extraordinary ability to defuse arguments with humor, diplomacy, and the occasional
complimentary drink. But when he says something seriously, the room tends to listen. He
certainly has his secrets, questionable old acquaintances, and a complicated past, but is never
an antagonist.

Portrayal. Virgil is charismatic, affable, quick-witted, and unusually difficult to offend. He calls
nearly everyone "friend," remembers names remarkably well, and has a habit of polishing his
gold tooth with his tongue when considering a difficult proposition. He's easygoing but by no
means foolish.

Appearance. A broad-shouldered fellow in his late fifties, with graying hair, an impressive
mustache, and a prominent gold tooth that catches the light whenever he smiles.

No one really knows Virgil’s connection to the guildhall's pocket dimension. Some say he won
the place in a wager. Others, that he inherited it from a former adventuring companion. Some
even whisper Virgil isn't actually its owner, merely its most recent caretaker. Getting a straight
answer out of him is like tryin' to saddle a tornado.
alignment_note: Suggested alignment in index, not an established assignment.
